# Traveling salesman: Soar agent from the Rosie teaching script

**Runnable.** `traveling-salesman.soar` loads the shared library (`Soar/soar-library`, v2.42) and `traveling-salesman-rules.soar` (13 task rules, generated by `gen.py` from the statements in `english-input.txt`; `tools/rosie_grid.py`). Generated 18 Nov 2026. Needs Soar 9.6.6 (or the PyPI soar-sml bindings).

## Run

    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . traveling-salesman.soar --seed 1 --cap 60000
    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . traveling-salesman.soar --json | python3 ../../tools/check_moves.py traveling-salesman init-tourrc.world

`python3 gen.py WORLD` writes the same rules with another example state as the initial world.

## Results (library v2.42, 18 Nov 2026)

Example states (`gen.py WORLD`, `run_agent.py --check`): init-tourrc: goal false, failure false; final-tourrc: goal true, failure false.

Seeds 1-3, cap 60,000 decisions; plans replayed independently by `check_moves.py` (legality from the action statements, the losing conditions, the goal).

| Seed | Outcome | Decisions | Actions | Replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | success | 19,884 | 11 | goal holds |
| 2 | success | 19,842 | 11 | goal holds |
| 3 | success | 19,065 | 11 | goal holds |

## Translation

- Operator move-salesman ( argument1 = the red block, argument2 = the clear location),
  statement 5; adjacent (statement 8) is a static relation between locations (A-G1).
- "The solution has eleven steps" (statement 9) is checked against the plans, not used.
- available (not on a location) and clear are maintained one-argument relations; the blue blocks start in a stack, and the
  clear available blue block is its top, found by the applications (A-G4).
- covered (below an object) is expanded in place; the goal is expanded over the locations of the world file and adds a red block on a location adjacent to a green location.
Propose initialize-traveling-salesman when its conditions below hold.

The assumption codes (A-S, A-G, A-C, A-P) are explained in `tools/rosie_grid.py` and `../../PILOT.md`.
